claims.summary: The TUFS module defines 普通体 as a style using plain forms, distinguishes ダ体 and デアル体, and gives typical contexts including fiction, diaries, intimate conversation, and academic writing.

locators.description: Apartado 「これだけは覚えよう」, puntos 1–3: 普通体 usa formas simples; distinción ダ体／デアル体 y contextos de novela/diario/conversación íntima frente a textos académicos.
